about: Rules for the held-ground simulation (scripts/compile-front.ts). Gates: a side can take ground in a territory only from the event that opens that front, or never (fromEvent null). Anchored: in these territories a side's held ground is a band reaching in from its own border (a siege front tied to its homeland) rather than an area around its army. Each rule names its basis.

gates.basis: The Imperial Army has crossed the Tempest border (V13 Ch1). Before it, the column is inside the Empire and holds no Jura ground, whatever the reach of its numbers.

R6 scenario: Dwargon is never taken. Formation B's south-western offensive fails (EVT-0515) and the Gate force never passes the Dwargon Gate, so no imperial formation holds Dwargon ground; the fighting there is shown as a CONTESTED operational area instead. Replaces the R5 band from the imperial border, which assumed a siege pressed only from the east.
